purpose: Render only exact manifests into deterministic platform masters and measurable media outputs.
hard_gates: The renderer must consume exact approved manifests and preserve source audio duration and lineage.
soft_gates: Output should be perceptually equivalent across supported hardware even when MP4 bytes differ.

failure.fallback: Preserve the manifest and prior artifacts, report the capability failure and resume from render.

regression_cases: The same manifest yields the same edit decisions and perceptually equivalent output.
A render failure cannot erase the approved local package inputs.
